name: Hawks Creek Golf Club
_comment_tees: Scorecard from GolfPass (12709); its pars match OpenStreetMap's hole tags and its rated yards match the hole yards. Men's ratings, but Silver is rated for women only. Shady Oaks is next door: only what lies inside Hawks Creek's boundary is kept.
_comment_drop: Polygons containing these points are not part of the course: nothing.
